subject: SIG v16 change control & reconciliation request
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudtrust.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-12T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: SIG v16: change summary + request for consolidated re-answers

Hi Soojin,

We completed a baseline review of SIG v16 and identified a set of changes that affect your previously submitted answers (v13). Some items are minor wording changes; others change control expectations for data segregation and key management. Attached is a redline summary (SIG_v16_change_summary.pdf) and a suggested re-answer spreadsheet.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide updated answers and evidence for the subset of controls we flagged by Jan 22? The primary areas: key lifecycle, restricted admin ops, and transit encryption for inter-service traffic.

If it helps, we can accept a consolidated re-answer workbook and a short evidence map linking to artifacts. Thanks — we want to keep your review on track for our procurement timeline.

Best,
Samantha
CloudTrust Security

Attachments: SIG_v16_change_summary.pdf

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudtrust.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-12T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v16: change summary + request for consolidated re-answers

Hi Samantha — thanks for the early heads-up and the change summary. I looked through the PDF and agree a consolidated response is the right approach.

Marcus, can you and your team review the redline and start mapping evidence for the KMS/key lifecycle items? Laura — flagging for procurement cadence and to confirm whether the Jan 22 date aligns with the SOW timeline.

We plan to: 1) produce a draft workbook with proposed re-answers, 2) attach an evidence_map.csv linking to Drive artifacts, and 3) call out any items that will need policy updates (approx ETA in my next note).

I will circulate the draft internally by EOD 2026-01-15.

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-14T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v16: change summary + request for consolidated re-answers

Looping in the infra owners — we ran an initial mapping against our evidence catalog. Quick notes: 

- KMS/key lifecycle: existing rotation and CMKs cover service encryption; we need a short write-up for cross-service key usage and a current KMS policy doc. Likely attachment: kms_lifecycle_overview.pdf.
- Restricted admin ops: we have role-based controls and just-in-time (JIT) elevation; need logs from Jan–Dec 2025 to show approval flow. Generating report: admin_approval_audit_2025.csv (may be redacted).
- Transit encryption between microservices: most traffic is mTLS. A couple internal connectors still use TLS with mutual auth pending; those will be remediated or documented as compensating controls.

I will compile the re-answers spreadsheet as a first draft and drop it in Drive by 2026-01-15 17:00 PST.

— Marcus
Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Security

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudtrust.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-15T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v16: change summary + request for consolidated re-answers

Samantha — quick note from the procurement side. Jan 22 is tight but doable for a consolidated workbook + evidence pointers. If you need signed attestations or a notarized evidence package, tell us now so we can route approvals.

Also, is CloudTrust expecting the re-answers to replace prior submissions or to live alongside them as a delta file? We can provide a full workbook and a separate "delta" sheet that lists changed Qs/answers.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudtrust.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-16T17:22:00-08:00
Subject: Draft re-answers + diff matrix for SIG v16 (internal)

Attached: SIG_v16_reanswers_draft.xlsx, evidence_map_v16.csv

Team — attached is the internal draft. Highlights: 42 questions changed in scope; we recommend producing a delta sheet with the 42 items and a short rationale column. For three questions where architecture changed (Q4.2, Q7.1, Q11.3) we marked the proposed answer as "Updated - requires evidence".

Notes for Samantha: we've included a "Trace" column linking to Drive IDs and an evidence_map.csv listing artifact names and brief descriptions. A sample evidence bullet: kms_policy_v3.pdf — documents rotation schedule and separation of duties.

Marcus

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@cloudtrust.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-20T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft re-answers + diff matrix for SIG v16 (internal)

Thanks, Marcus and team — that draft looks thorough and the delta approach is perfect. A couple follow-ups before we close the review: 

1) Please submit the final consolidated workbook as an XLSX and include the delta sheet as the first tab.
2) For the three architecture-impact items, we need the KMS policy PDF and an excerpt of the JIT approval audit showing a recent approval. Redact user identifiers if needed.
3) Also include the Drive link to the evidence folder so we can spot-check artifacts.

If you can get the final package to me by end of day on Jan 22, we'll mark the SIG update as "pending verification" and proceed with procurement onboarding next week.

Samantha
CloudTrust Security

Attachments received earlier: SIG_v16_change_summary.pdf, SIG_v16_reanswers_draft.xlsx, evidence_map_v16.csv
